about: OpenStreetMap (openstreetmap.org), the free editable world map. This CLI searches places, reads map elements, their history and raw data, gets routes, exports map data for a bounding box, and reads changesets, user profiles, diaries and communities.

commands.summary: Geocode a place name or address with Nominatim, the search engine openstreetmap.org uses. Returns OSM type/id, coordinates and display name.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of results (1-40) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: viewbox
params.description: Preferred area as minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat. Results inside it are ranked higher.

params.name: exclude_place_ids
params.description: Comma-separated place_ids to exclude. Use it to get more results after a first page.

commands.summary: Get the detail page of an OSM node, way or relation: name, current version, last editor, changeset, edit comment and tags (as text).

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric OSM element id (osm_id from search-places)

commands.summary: List every version of an OSM node, way or relation, with version number, editor, timestamp, changeset and comment.
Get raw OSM data as JSON for a way or relation together with all its member nodes (coordinates, tags, versions, editors).

params.name: element_type
params.description: Element type (only ways and relations have /full)

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric OSM way or relation id

commands.summary: Download all raw OSM data (nodes, ways, relations) in a small bounding box as JSON. This is what the Export button returns.

params.name: bbox
params.description: Bounding box minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat. Must be small (well under 0.25 square degrees and 50,000 nodes), otherwise 400.

commands.summary: Get turn-by-turn directions between two coordinates with the OSRM engine (FOSSGIS) for car, bike or foot. Returns distance in meters and duration in seconds.
Get directions with the Valhalla engine (FOSSGIS). Returns human-readable maneuvers, length and time.

params.name: json
params.description: Valhalla request as a JSON string: {"locations":[{"lat":..,"lon":..},{"lat":..,"lon":..}],"costing":"auto|bicycle|pedestrian","directions_options":{"units":"kilometers"}}

commands.summary: List recent changesets (edit sessions) in a bounding box, newest first. Use --before for older ones.

params.name: before
params.description: Only changesets with id lower than this. Pass the last changeset id of the previous page.

commands.summary: List a user's changesets (edits), newest first. Use --before for older ones.

params.name: before
params.description: Only changesets with id lower than this (pagination cursor)

commands.summary: Get a mapper's public profile: edit count, mapper-since date, last edit date and description.
Get a user's contribution count for the last year (from the activity heatmap).
List the latest user diary entries from all languages, newest first. Use --before for older ones.

params.name: before
params.description: Only entries with id lower than this. Pass the last entry id of the previous page.

commands.summary: List the latest diary entries written in one language (e.g. en, de, fr), newest first.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, fr, es

params.name: before
params.description: Only entries with id lower than this (pagination cursor)

commands.summary: Read one diary entry: title, author, date, full text, location and the comment discussion.

params.name: username
params.description: Author's display name (from the entry url /user/{name}/diary/{id})

commands.summary: List the official OpenStreetMap Local Chapters (country or regional organisations) with their websites.
